integrity: Claims are proved analytically using explicit singular values, strict log-concavity, lattice counting, layer cake, and rational integration. Finite diagnostic code is supporting evidence, not a proof of universal assertions.
scientific_limitations: Equal-normalized-boundary Hardy annuli; positive integral monomial degrees; nonnormal cross-adjoint commutator. No general-symbol extension, independent validation, or global publication-priority guarantee. The exact coefficient formula and diagonal-degree law are established prior knowledge.
title: A two-degree spectral crossover for annular Hardy cross-commutators
